final_assessment: Every open question walked and decided with Sal. rc05 is rescoped to every generated surface and `orbit` first, grammar only, as ONE new capability: an exported program builder with commander's own parser as the validator, an extractor over shell fences and inline spans located by a dev-only CommonMark library, a guard against commands outside shell fences, and a parity test holding the completion registry to the program. `git` and the `gh` sweep's move split into a child stage, rc05b-git-grammar. Exits restated: no escapes and the surface parses; every check shown able to fail; the stage's own blind pair finds zero orbit grammar defects. Five rules accounted, two with BOUNDED residuals.

residuals.kind: a tool invoked by a snippet the enumeration did not see: one not installed on the measuring machine, one written path-prefixed (`./bin/orbit.js`, `node bin/orbit.js`), or one following `&&`, `|` or `;` mid-line
residuals.method: rerun the enumeration without the PATH filter, splitting each candidate on `&&`, `|` and `;`, and classify every unrecognised token by reading its line

residuals.kind: a command in a container not listed: a blockquote, an indented code block, an HTML block, a table cell, or mid-line after `&&`, `$ ` or `|`
residuals.method: the guard itself reads every line whatever its container, so a residual member that starts a line fails it; a member mid-line is found by splitting candidate lines on `&&`, `;` and `|` and rerunning the guard
